title: Variable row-height support and lateral filter rail for virtual table
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem statement: Our current virtualized table assumes fixed row height and a top-mounted filter bar. Real product datasets contain mixed-height rows (avatars, multi-line descriptions, badges) which cause jank when measuring and when jumping between scroll anchors. Product teams also need a persistent, discoverable filter surface that doesn’t consume vertical space in dense views.

Goal: Add first-class support in the design system for variable row heights (measuring strategy + graceful fallback) and introduce an optional right-side lateral filter rail that: (a) preserves vertical density, (b) supports multi-select filters and saved filter sets, and (c) works seamlessly with keyboard-first navigation and screen readers. Deliverables: design tokens updates for spacing, new interaction spec for resize + measurement, high-fidelity prototypes (desktop & tablet), accessibility checklist, and a handoff doc for engineering with perf constraints and test cases.
acceptance_criteria: Design spec includes clear measurement strategy: estimated row height, progressive hydration, and cache invalidation policy
Prototype demonstrates <10ms perceived scroll jank on 100k-row synthetic workload (engineering verified)
Lateral filter rail prototype includes keyboard focus order, ARIA labels, and works with nvda/VoiceOver basic flows
Column resize interactions remain stable when row heights vary; snap candidates described for 25/50/75 percentile widths
Tokens updated for two new density presets (compact-plus, spacious) and documented contrast with existing density tokens
Design handoff includes test prompts and screenshot references for regressions and a checklist for QA
engineering_tasks: ENG-21109: implement progressive row-height measurement API and expose measurement hooks
ENG-21110: KV cache invalidation on row-height change signal
ENG-21111: lateral filter rail API + state persistence (saved-presets) and analytics events
ENG-21112: update Table virtualization layer to accept 'preferredHeight' and 'measuredHeight' with fallback to fixed-height path
ENG-21113: end-to-end perf test with 100k rows and mixed content; attach benchmark results to ticket
comments: 2025-10-17 - Aisha: Kickoff research note added. Row-height survey of 12 customer tables attached in Drive. Hypothesis: progressive hydration + optimistic height reduces reflow across common datasets.
2025-10-20 - Marco: Sync with infra & runtime teams. Agreed to expose a light-weight 'heightHint' prop that can be set by product components to avoid immediate measurements on initial render.
2025-10-26 - UX review: Decided to make lateral filter rail opt-in and not force into compact row mode. Rail will have a collapsed icon-only state and an expanded state with saved filters at the top.
2025-10-29 - Accessibility review: Added focus trap guidance for rail and explicit ARIA role 'region' with aria-label. Need engineering to verify reading order when rail is programmatically opened.

2025-11-01 - Engineering lead (Priya Das): Implemented measurement shim in platform branch; early perf shows 12% reduction in reflows on sample dataset. Follow-up PR linked. Need UX to confirm animation easing and placeholder density token.
2025-11-02 - Aisha: Added acceptance criteria around snap points for column resize. Requested design QA run on Mac VoiceOver and NVDA Windows by 2025-11-10.
notes_for_engineering:
- Performance constraints: initial render must not block main thread for >16ms per frame. Provide an opt-out to fixed-height render for legacy clients.
- Measurement API contract: measure(node) -> { height: number, stable: boolean } and a 'stabilityTTL' token-controlled timeout.
- Telemetry: emit events for 'rail_open','rail_close','filter_apply','row_measure_miss' to allow product to correlate with latency spikes.
qa_checklist: Render mixed-height rows with avatars, multi-line descriptions, and badges - ensure no visual overlap when scrolling rapidly
Toggle lateral filter rail - ensure keyboard focus order and screen reader reading order are preserved
Column resize while variable-height rows present - verify UI doesn't jump and snap behavior is as specified
Verify density tokens for compact-plus and spacious match design spec values (spacing, font-size, row-padding)
Run perf harness with 100k rows and attach flame graphs
